_meta.reference_definition: Asking rent in THB/month for a roughly 30–35 m² 1BR or 60–70 m² 2BR condo, excluding serviced apartments and short stays. Typical editorial corridor estimate, not a statistical median.
_meta.definition: Published median condo asking rent by bedroom count within the source’s 800 m station radius, all floor areas. A proxy for the reference metric; lease duration and serviced-unit exclusion are not verified.
_meta.grid_policy: Grid rent remains district editorial; only station-area rent and affordability ratings use overrides.
